# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan Continues — His Refusal and Fall

---

**6:1** 'But Michael urged all the angels and said to them: "Worship the image of the Lord God, as the Lord God has commanded." And Michael himself worshiped first and then called me and said: "Worship the image of God."'

**6:2** 'But I said: "I will not worship Adam." And when Michael pressed me, I said: "Why do you compel me? I will not worship one who is inferior to me and after me. I am prior to that creature; before him was I made. He ought to worship me."'

**6:3** 'And when the other angels who were with me heard my words, they also refused to worship him. And Michael said to me: "Worship the image of God. But if you do not worship, the Lord God will be wrathful with you."'

**6:4** 'And I said: "If he is wrathful with me, I will place my seat above the stars of heaven and I will be like the Most High."'

**6:5** 'And the Lord God was wrathful with me and commanded me to be cast out of heaven with my angels.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
